I'll reason as this farmer, then give the JSON.

**My thinking:**

I have 10.9 mu. Most of it I plant wheat then maize — that is what I have always done, same as my neighbors. I keep about 7 mu for wheat-maize. The rest I use for vegetables and melon because they bring more money at market. I give 1 mu to eggplant, 1 mu to tomato, and the last 1.9 mu to watermelon.

For wheat, I put down one bag of compound (50 jin, the 15-15-15 kind) before planting, and in spring when it turns green I spread 50 jin of urea. That is what I did last year and I got about 450 kg. If I put less, I am scared the wheat will be yellow.

For maize after wheat, I don't plough, I just push the seed in with the seeder. I buy Zhengdan hybrid from the dealer — everyone buys it. One bag compound at sowing, then 50 jin urea when it is knee-high. I water 2 times if no rain.

For eggplant and tomato, I use more fertilizer because they eat a lot. I put 2 bags compound and some chicken manure I buy from the chicken farm, then urea twice during growing. I must spray many times — if I don't, the bugs eat everything and I lose all money. Water often from the well, maybe every 7-8 days.

Watermelon I plant hybrid seed, put compound plus manure, spray maybe 4 times. Water less than vegetables or the melon is not sweet.

I stick close to what I did last year. Fertilizer is expensive but losing harvest is worse.
